encoding: Opaque #rrggbb sRGB colors. Original alpha expressions and compositing choices are retained for One variants.
canonical_policy: Use full official named palettes, not ANSI-only substitutions or majority votes. Preserve unused colors, aliases, exact identifiers and nested namespaces. Palette usage explicitly marks unused entries.
comparison_policy: Every provided alternative RGB field is checked for exact canonical value membership; this is not same-role agreement. Declared background/default text roles are additionally compared. Different versions, variants, role maps and missing alternatives remain explicit.
contrast_policy: Semantic roles retain canonical foreground/background colors, subdued secondary text and separators, an accent hotkey, red/rose errors, yellow pending states, orange/yellow blocked states, green reloads and cyan/blue notices where the palette supports them. Choose existing named swatches for role meaning and hierarchy; do not replace an accent with neutral text solely to meet a universal contrast threshold. Record each role and inverted hotkey badge using sRGB relative luminance against its actual background. The 4.5:1 normal-text reference is a comparison, not a gate or an accessibility guarantee. Below-reference choices remain explicit; terminal dimming, font rendering and inherited terminal colors are not measured.
normalization: Hex letter case is normalized without numerical changes. Dracula human-readable row labels use documented snake_case aliases. Nested palette names and array indices use dotted paths. One HSL/Less and alpha normalization is recorded per source expression. NONE/no-color sentinels and non-color metadata are not RGB swatches.
